title: events/types/mutation.reverted
description: Payload for event_type 'mutation.reverted' (feature 016; FR-1409/1410): a promoted mutation's episode scored strictly worse than the recorded baseline, so the parent pack content was restored at the boundary. Only ever follows a mutation.promoted lineage row.

pack_hash.description: Canonical hash restored (equals the parent_hash of the reverted lineage).

restored_parent.description: Backup file path the pack was restored from.

episode_score.description: improve.score of the episode run under the promoted pack.

baseline_score.description: Score recorded at promotion; episode_score > baseline_score triggered the revert.
